_note: Toolbar icon concept v1 (2026-09-23, coordinator Opus 5.5). 24x24, stroke 1.5, currentColor. Tints use opacity (uzor svg.rs gains opacity support in the same wave). Scan tools share one motif: range brackets [ ] around the family glyph = drag over a range. v2 adds the right-toolbar micro-icons (DOM, TT, L2, BT, LIQ, SCR) and enlarges the inner glyph of the scan tools.
